name: Knell, The Lunatic Resonator
desc:
Knell, The Lunatic Resonator is a humanoid Boss found in [Simforea](location:simforea), an island in the [Voidsea](location:voidsea) within the [Eastern Luminant](location:luminants).

During the time of the Old World, Knell was an inhabitant of Simforea, where he was a scholar. Knell had a keen fascination with sound, which became the object of his research, and in particular was drawn to bells and chimes of various designs. This translated to him frequently adorning his apparel and crafts with the instruments.

Knell also hoped to one day obtain a Resonance. To help with this, he had his clothes infused with Indichite. Such a process could help his soul better resonate, but was also unstable.

Eventually, Simforea and its inhabitants disappeared from the world. Knell was left on his lonesome and was driven mad over the centuries within the Voidsea. Though Knell avoided total loss of his mental faculties, thanks to the steady pounding of his soul, his mind became laser-focused on his desire to resonate. However, his soul had been left in a discordant state, ensuring he would never be able to attain what he so badly craved.

At some point, Knell met an individual he referred to as Ten, who promised him that his soul would be mended and that he would finally obtain a Resonance.

Knell also used Arkasid husks and Simforea's native plant life to craft the Bellmarrow Reave, its engravings reflecting his current state of mind.

When Simforea drifted through the Voidsea near to the [Eastern Luminant](location:luminants), Knell was effectively returned to the world after centuries. Witnessing The Pathfinder's own Resonance, a frenzied Knell believed killing them would finally put an end to his troubles. Knell attacked them and was ultimately killed in the ensuing fight.
additional_info:
-   Knell's name comes from the noun used to describe the sound of a bell, especially when rung solemnly for a death or funeral.
-   Knell is the only entity whose title in the Bestiary differs from their usual name.
-   Knell's final Bestiary name is a possible reference to the song "For Whom The Bell Tolls" by Metallica, as they also had a previous Metallica based event featuring their 72 seasons album release, here.
-   Knell and his fight appear to be heavily inspired by the boss Widow from _Hollow Knight: Silksong_. Both have extremely similar attacks with rushdown swipes, and the myriads of thrown bell attacks. The two also share a design detail of two pins lodged in their backs.
-   Knell does not respawn after being defeated, on account of being dead. If one wishes to fight him again, one must ask [Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts](entity:yunshul_keeper_of_hearts) to return him from [The Depths](location:the_depths) to the surface via an Idol of Yun'Shul or the [Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts](entity:shrine_of_yunshul_keeper_of_hearts).
    -   This makes Knell the only boss to permanently die in the Pathfinder gamemode without player input:
        -   [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract), Raeva Ferash Kenestos and the [Scion of Ethiron](entity:scion_of_ethiron) are revived by the temporal anomalies present in [New Kyrsa](location:new_kyrsa).
        -   [The Doom of Caeranthil](entity:the_doom_of_caeranthil), the [Dread Serpent](entity:dread_serpent), the [Interluminary Parasol](entity:interluminary_parasol), and [Primadon, Titan of the East](entity:elder_primadon_the_titan_warlord) will respawn, either due to being species comprised of multiple individuals or simply for gameplay convenience.(Or they may simply swim out the Depths, true reason, however, will most likely remain unknown,)
        -   [Duke Ishamon Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia) will escape the Depths himself.
        -   The fights against [The Ferryman](entity:the_ferryman), the [Heart of Enmity](entity:heart_of_enmity), [Maestro Evengarde Rest](entity:evengarde_rest) and [Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus) are not to the death.
-   Roblox clothing: Shirt • Pants
